message.content: {"objective": "Promote the b5 passed pawn while the a4 king contains Black's d3 passer.", "rationale": "b5b6 is the sole commit_ready move: exact depth-4 score -858, corroborated by two analyses with no mate or tactical refutation, and safety.complete with no mating reply. Both b5b6 and a4a5 reach -858 in the broad search, but only b5b6 is verified commit-ready. Advancing the passer immediately is the fastest promotion race; Black's d-pawn also promotes, so White must rely on the a4 king's proximity to the queenside to hold. This is a drawn/lost theoretical ending either way, but b5b6 keeps the pawn active and forces Black to spend a tempo on d3-d2.", "action": "commit", "move": "b5b6"}
